overview.title: Another water stop on the plateau
overview.p1: Dayet Hachlaf is a second lake option in the Ifrane area, often quieter than Dayet Aoua. It works well if you want a second water stop or if Aoua is busy on a weekend.
overview.p2: Expect a simple natural shoreline rather than resorts. Bring what you need for a short walk and picnic.
overview.p3: Combine with Aoua only if you have a full day and a car. Otherwise pick one lake and do it properly.
